Smart and powerful currency converter.

+ Works offline.
+ 140 world currencies.
+ Cryptocurrencies.
+ Currencies list.
+ Current exchange rates.
+ Camera price recognition and convertion.
+ Camera restaurant menu translation and convertion.
+ Translation up to 50 languages.
+ Online support 24/7.

Full access options:
1. The monthly premium subscription involves a monthly payment of $2.99 for unlocking all the features.
2. The annual premium subscription involves a annual payment of $$25.99 for unlocking all the features.
